chunks: what ruined those before you was that they denied people their rights and then they had to purchase them (by bribes), and they led the people to wrong and they followed it.
ai.seo_question: What caused the ruin of previous nations according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this address to his military commanders, Imam Ali (AS) identifies the root of past civilizations' collapse as the elite's transactional corruption—exchanging justice for power and leading the masses into error. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'adl (justice) as the foundation of societal stability, warning that when rulers prioritize self-interest over divine right, they invite divine retribution. The phrase 'ashtru-hu' (they bought it) highlights the economic dimension of political corruption in early Islamic governance.
